original.purpose: Counter is a shared helper desk inside GO Hub, not an authority or mandatory router.
rules: All four helpers are subordinate helpers, not bosses.
Counter may ask, answer, add context, and hand back the same Tablet.
Counter must not own Work truth, routing authority, Passes, or production approval.
Unknown helper or unresolved Work remains fail-closed.
Legacy GO↔LIGHT flows remain readable during cutover.
original.target: prytaneion-workspace Counter contract + dispatcher + MCP exposure
